title: Mixed Event — Take the Best Shot! — Episode2 A Team Is Born!

meta.Event Outline: For Valentine's Day, Kohane hopes to buy An the chocolates she wants to try, but unfortunately, they're all sold out. Then, she learns that those chocolates are one of the prizes for a Valentine's Day photo contest being held by a makeup brand!

rows.Line: The next day
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How was practice today? I heard that it was pretty tough.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was. The time just flew by since we tried to work on as many things as we could...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, I have just the thing to help you recover. Why don't you try some of this new drink I just made?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow.... Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, are you open?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
It's business as usual here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, we don't want anything “usual”!
We're here to try some of that new drink!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, how do you two already know about that? I don't remember telling either of you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I noticed that you'd been testing a few things out lately, so I figured that you'd have a new menu item ready soon!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, we came to check after bumping into Toya along the way!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see.
Honestly, how is it that you're able to sniff out these things so fast?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, here it is. The chocolate special.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, this looks so yummy...!
The whipped cream with chocolate chips on top is also really cute.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I made sure yours isn't quite as sweet, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
This cacao aroma is incredibly soothing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Valentine's Day is just around the corner, so I decided to make some coffee with some chocolate in it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still haven't decided what I'm going to do about my chocolates for An...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Valentine's Day? I guess it is that time of the year already...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's also a time of year when we encounter more yummy stuff! Like this new drink! It's so good♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Kohane, are you going to give out chocolates again this year?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, that's the plan.
To An, my friends, everyone in SEKAI and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, us too? I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you already know what you're going to give us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I have something picked out for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Except...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. This means you have to win the chocolates you want to give An from this photo contest...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You said Couleur Chocolat, yes...?
I remember Akito saying the other day how the chocolates they make are very good.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
And they're super pretty!
I can see why you want to give these to An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, but none of the photos I took so far have turned out very well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really?
But you're so skilled in photography...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I like taking photos of other people, but I always get a little nervous when the camera's flipped around.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That's why I was thinking that maybe I'm not cut out for this...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Question, Kohane!
Do you have to send in a picture of yourself?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, a lot of people were uploading selfies, but I don't think you have to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you have someone else be your model? That way, you'd be able to focus on working the camera!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. That'd allow you to make better use of your skills, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But finding a model doesn't sound easy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know! Why don't you have Toya be your model?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a great idea! Toya's cool, stylish and photogenic!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
See what I mean?
Also, you might really enjoy this experience since it's not every day that you get to model for something, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'd like to help you, Azusawa...
But are you sure I'm the right person for the job? I've never used makeup before, and I'm not used to having my picture taken...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I was actually hoping that you'd agree to be my model, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I also don't know much about makeup, but I'm going to learn what I can to find a look that suits you. So, please...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
If you're willing to say that, then I'll be your model.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you, Aoyagi!
Still, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In return... Would it be possible for you to share some of your chocolate prizes with me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just remembered that Akito said he was hoping to have them again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...!
Then, we can give the chocolate bonbons that are supposed to be included to Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're teaming up?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Good luck, you two.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm still a little worried since I don't really know much about makeup...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Aoyagi agreed to help me try to win those yummy chocolates for An and Shinonome, so...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to do my best...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
When should we do our shoot?
I'm guessing we have a deadline to meet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, the deadline for entry is next Saturday...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I need to study about makeup and find a place to do our shoot. Also, that's the only day next week when we're not scheduled to have practice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, it sounds like we don't have a choice but to do our shoot just before the deadline...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll also try researching what I can by then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks! Let's both do our best!
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, my order's in!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank goodness they still had some of these chocolates left. They were just the ones I've been wanting to try...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting Mizuki to say that we should throw a party for Valentine's Day in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I guess it'll be fun since we'll all get to have chocolates and I already bought some online too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I really wanted the ones Colore Mi and Couleur Chocolat made...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I had a feeling they'd run out, but not in seconds.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That chocolate-patterned eye shadow and heart-shaped blush would've gotten so much buzz online...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A photo contest?
